source: 外研社必修第二册 Unit 1 同主题完形(餐厅就餐/跟奶奶学做饭/食堂变健康/初尝榴莲/英式下午茶/探店博主)。用词限 U1/初中/常见词,每空答案唯一、四选项同词性,与阅读听力不撞文章。

passages.title: A Meal Out

passages.title: A Healthier Canteen

passages.title: My First Durian
passages.text: During a trip to South-east Asia, my friend dared me to (1)____ a durian, a fruit famous for its strong smell. passages.title: Afternoon Tea
